assumptions.statement: Paid conversion off one send is lower than the 5.1% free-signup rate observed off a comparable send, because the ask now carries a price.
assumptions.basis: Stated assumption used to size the study, not a benchmark; no external conversion figures have been sourced.

assumptions.statement: The lifetime-value steps assume a constant monthly cancellation hazard.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Real subscription churn is usually front-loaded, which would make true lifetime shorter than the model implies. The 41% floor is therefore optimistic, and a result sitting just above it should be read as weaker than it looks.
